description: Defines the StableVideoDecoderFactoryService class, which provides an interface for creating and managing stable video decoders within a media process, including testing hooks and receiver binding.

classes.name: StableVideoDecoderFactoryService
classes.description: A service class that creates and manages stable video decoders, intended to run inside a video decoder process, with testing hooks and receiver binding capabilities.

methods.name: StableVideoDecoderFactoryService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with GPU feature info and decoder enable flag.

methods.name: SetVideoDecoderCreationCallbackForTesting
methods.description: Sets a callback for creating video decoders, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: BindReceiver
methods.description: Binds a receiver to the service, allowing it to handle decoder creation requests.

methods.name: CreateStableVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a stable video decoder and binds it to the provided receiver.
